# A school of three fish circling the reef: Orbit (an empty, one turn in 12 s, counter-clockwise
# seen from above) > Fish bodies at radius 2.9-3.7 m, heights 1.6-2.4 m > a Tail on each that flicks
# +-30 degrees every 4 frames (12 fps). Bodies and tails are joined parts: 6 bones. The fish face -Y at
# rest; each is turned 180 + its angle so it swims forward along its circle. Sizes exaggerated for the splat grid (body 0.62 long).
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
fps 12
frame range 0 144
material new Scale --base-color 0.624 0.957 0.898 --no-slot
material new Fin --base-color 0.000 0.725 0.745 --no-slot
add empty --name Orbit --location 0 0 0
add mesh ico-sphere --name Body0 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.2 0.62 0.34
apply --scale
material assign Scale
add mesh cube --name Dorsal0 --size 1 --location 0 0.04 0.19
scale 0.06 0.24 0.14
apply
material assign Fin
select Dorsal0 Body0
active Body0
join
add mesh cube --name Tail0 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.06 0.3 0.34
apply --scale
material assign Fin
active Tail0
mode edit
select all
translate 0 0.15 0
select vert where "pos.y > 0.2"
scale 1 1 1.5
mode object
select Tail0
set location 0 0.3 0
select Tail0 Body0
parent set Body0
select Body0
set location 3.200 0.000 1.6
set rotation 0 0 180.0
select Body0 Orbit
parent set Orbit
add mesh ico-sphere --name Body1 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.2 0.62 0.34
apply --scale
material assign Scale
add mesh cube --name Dorsal1 --size 1 --location 0 0.04 0.19
scale 0.06 0.24 0.14
apply
material assign Fin
select Dorsal1 Body1
active Body1
join
add mesh cube --name Tail1 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.06 0.3 0.34
apply --scale
material assign Fin
active Tail1
mode edit
select all
translate 0 0.15 0
select vert where "pos.y > 0.2"
scale 1 1 1.5
mode object
select Tail1
set location 0 0.3 0
select Tail1 Body1
parent set Body1
select Body1
set location 3.353 1.564 2.1
set rotation 0 0 205.0
select Body1 Orbit
parent set Orbit
add mesh ico-sphere --name Body2 --subdivisions 1 --radius 0.5 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.2 0.62 0.34
apply --scale
material assign Scale
add mesh cube --name Dorsal2 --size 1 --location 0 0.04 0.19
scale 0.06 0.24 0.14
apply
material assign Fin
select Dorsal2 Body2
active Body2
join
add mesh cube --name Tail2 --size 1 --location 0 0 0
scale 0.06 0.3 0.34
apply --scale
material assign Fin
active Tail2
mode edit
select all
translate 0 0.15 0
select vert where "pos.y > 0.2"
scale 1 1 1.5
mode object
select Tail2
set location 0 0.3 0
select Tail2 Body2
parent set Body2
select Body2
set location 1.864 2.222 2.4
set rotation 0 0 230.0
select Body2 Orbit
parent set Orbit
select Orbit
frame set 0
set rotation 0 0 0
keyframe insert --channels rot
frame set 144
set rotation 0 0 360
keyframe insert --channels rot
select Tail0
frame set 0
set rotation 0 0 30
keyframe insert --channels rot
frame set 4
set rotation 0 0 -30
